## About
Affordable Home Builders of Texas is a general contractor working out of Hammerly Blvd in Houston. We build outdoor living spaces, room additions and complete remodels, and we aim to deliver quality work at affordable prices.
A lot of our work happens out back: outdoor kitchens, pavilions and pergolas, porches, sunrooms, decks, fences and patio covers. Inside the house, we handle kitchens, bathrooms, room additions and full remodels.
Homeowners have given us a 4.5 rating on Google from 36 reviews. If you want to see what we've built around Houston, take a look at our photo gallery, then give us a call.

## Services
- Outdoor kitchens and bars: Cooking and gathering space built into your backyard for relaxing and entertaining.
- Pavilions and pergolas: Covered and open-air structures that make your yard more usable.
- Wood and composite decks: Decks built to fit your home. One reviewer had a covered deck built with integrated lighting.
- Porches and sunrooms: More living space that connects your home to the outdoors.
- Room additions: Add living and entertaining square footage to your home.
- Complete kitchen remodel: A full remodel of your kitchen.
- Complete bathroom remodel: A full remodel of your bathroom.

## FAQ
Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We're based in Houston and serve Harris, Fort Bend, Montgomery, Brazoria, Galveston, Liberty, Waller, Chambers, Austin and Washington counties.

Q: How do I get started?
A: Call us or send a message through our contact form to set up a no-obligation consultation.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, Saturday from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM.
